raw: {"report": "Axial noncontrast CT images of the brain demonstrate marked enlargement of the frontal sinuses with opacification and loss of normal air-fluid levels. No acute intracranial hemorrhage or midline shift is identified.", "findings": [{"finding": "frontal sinusitis", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "hydrocephalus", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "There is a large, heterogeneous mass lesion in the left parietal lobe with surrounding vasogenic edema. {"report": "The first image demonstrates a hyperdense lesion within the frontal lobe with surrounding hypodensity suggestive of edema. {"report": "Axial CT images of the abdomen demonstrate a large, heterogeneous mass arising from the left kidney with extension into the renal sinus and perinephric space. {"report": "Axial CT image of the chest demonstrates a large, well-defined soft tissue mass located in the anterior mediastinum. {"report": "Axial noncontrast CT of the abdomen demonstrates a large, well-circumscribed, hypodense mass arising from the left kidney. {"report": "Axial CT images of the pelvis demonstrate a large, well-defined, hypodense mass occupying the central pelvic cavity. {"report": "Axial CT images of the chest demonstrate a large, well-defined, hyperdense mass located in the anterior mediastinum. {"report": "The bladder is distended and demonstrates a large, heterogeneous soft tissue mass filling the lumen. {"report": "There is a large, lobulated, calcified mass arising from the posterior aspect of the distal femur. {"report": "The frontal abdominal radiograph demonstrates massive bilateral lower quadrant distension with a large, rounded soft tissue mass effect, suggestive of significant organomegaly. {"report": "Axial CT with contrast demonstrates a large, heterogeneous soft tissue mass in the right gluteal region extending into the iliacus muscle. {"report": "The coronal CT image demonstrates a focal bony outgrowth arising from the inferior aspect of one vertebral body, projecting into the intervertebral disc space.
